en: A black-and-white image of a large industrial complex with multiple smokestacks, factory buildings, and a railway track curving through the foreground. The surrounding area features densely packed worker housing and industrial infrastructure, with hills visible in the background. There is a faint number or code in the bottom left corner, and an overall early 20th-century feel.
